summary: Verified Area 4 (Payer Checkout UX) across hosted checkout (CleanCheckoutV2) and creator inline tip checkout (InlineTipCheckout) on desktop 1440, mobile 390, and dark mode. All requirements PASS: (1) 3-step timeline transitions detected -> confirming -> paid using mocked verifyCryptoPayment (waiting -> pending -> confirmed); (2) In-place 'Refresh quote' on expired re-calls /api/pay/addPayment WITHOUT URL change or coin re-pick on BOTH hosted and inline; (3) AssetNetworkChip renders 'LTC · Litecoin' next to send-amount on both checkouts; (4) Desktop QR is 200px (SVG size 198x198 in-frame); (5) Overpayment note (excess credited to merchant) and Underpayment banner (send remaining X to same address) both wired to correct data-testids and show correct copy; (6) Mobile 390 shows sticky summary bar with merchant name + total, no horizontal overflow; (7) Dark mode: chip legible, QR panel remains white background, timeline+amounts legible.
critical_code_review_comments: CleanCheckoutV2.tsx is 2276 lines — consider splitting phases (currency_select / awaiting / expired / confirmed) into sub-components; violates the >700-line file rule.
InlineTipCheckout.tsx is >1500 lines — same concern; extract the shared expired/refresh/timeline blocks (already partly in checkoutPrimitives.tsx) further.
seed_data_creation: None — used live read-only ref rNtQRX and mocked /api/pay/addPayment, /api/pay/verifyCryptoPayment, /api/pay/tip via page.route.
context_for_next_testing_agent: For hosted checkout use /pay?d=rNtQRX; for inline tip mock /api/pay/tip to return {data:{d:'rNtQRX'}} then click support-widget-submit on /devhub. verifyCryptoPayment response MUST be wrapped as {message, data:{status,...}} — the top-level {status} form is rejected by checkoutApi (which returns json.data). Timeline confirmed dwell is ~4s min so allow up to 8s for detected->paid transition.
